claims.claim: A local plugin object with `id` and `description` is defined in a workspace file (not an SDK built-in plugin).
tailor.config.ts registers the local plugin with `export const plugins = definePlugins(...)` (a named export called exactly `plugins`).
The plugin implements at least one hook that contributes an identifiable result: a generation-time hook that returns `files`, or a definition-time hook that returns tables or field extensions.
A reviewer can tell from the plugin source what the contribution is (file path and content, or the generated table/field) without running the project.
